events.title: Hugging Face demonstrates shared-weight training across four agents
events.title_zh: Hugging Face 演示四个 agent 共享权重训练
events.summary_en: Hugging Face published a reproducible TRL example in which four agents share one Qwen3-0.6B policy and learn from group outcomes. The demonstration trained for about five hours on two H200 GPUs at an estimated $50 and used a simple number-ordering task. It is an early recipe for multi-agent reinforcement learning, not evidence that swarm training improves production agents.
events.summary_zh: Hugging Face 发布一套可复现的 TRL 示例：四个 agent 共享同一个 Qwen3-0.6B 策略，并根据团队结果共同学习。演示在两张 H200 上训练约 5 小时，估算成本 50 美元，任务只是简单的数字排序。这是多 agent 强化学习的早期配方，不足以证明 swarm 训练能提升生产 agent。
events.why_it_matters_en: Agent researchers gain a small public baseline for testing shared-policy team learning without building the orchestration and reward loop from scratch.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 agent 研究团队来说，这提供了一个小型公开基线，可以直接测试共享策略的团队学习，而不必从零搭建编排与奖励循环。

events.title: NVIDIA opens training data and a speed path for Nemotron 3.5 Parse
events.title_zh: NVIDIA 开放 Nemotron 3.5 Parse 训练数据与加速方案
events.summary_en: NVIDIA released three synthetic datasets for Nemotron 3.5 Parse: 9.98 million chart samples, 1 million table samples and 7.9 million multilingual OCR samples, plus a fine-tuning recipe and DFlash2 speculator. Publisher tests report 7.62x higher single-request throughput on H200 and 1.52x at concurrency 512 versus Parse 3.5 without speculation. The assets are public, but the performance comparison comes from the release team.
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 为 Nemotron 3.5 Parse 开放三套合成数据：998 万图表样本、100 万表格样本和 790 万多语 OCR 样本，并给出微调方案与 DFlash2 推测解码模型。发布方在 H200 上测得，单请求吞吐比未启用推测解码的 Parse 3.5 高 7.62 倍，并发 512 时高 1.52 倍。资产已公开，但性能对比仍来自发布团队。
events.why_it_matters_en: Document-AI teams can now reproduce the data recipe and test a concrete latency path instead of relying only on model-card scores.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对文档 AI 团队来说，现在可以复现数据配方并测试一条明确的加速路径，不必只依赖模型卡分数。

events.title: llama.cpp publishes repeatable AMD performance tracking
events.title_zh: llama.cpp 发布可重复的 AMD 性能追踪
events.summary_en: llama.cpp launched a public AMD benchmark dashboard backed by raw results and reusable workflows. Weekly jobs run ten repetitions for prompt processing, token generation and context scaling across selected models and quantizations. Initial coverage is limited to Radeon 8060S and AI Pro R9700S systems, so it is a regression baseline rather than a broad AMD ranking.
events.summary_zh: llama.cpp 上线公开 AMD benchmark 看板，并提供原始结果与可复用工作流。每周任务对提示处理、token 生成和上下文扩展各跑 10 次，覆盖选定模型与量化配置。首批只覆盖 Radeon 8060S 与 AI Pro R9700S，因此它更适合作为回归基线，而不是完整的 AMD 性能排行榜。
events.why_it_matters_en: Teams deploying local models on AMD hardware gain a transparent way to detect regressions and choose configurations, with hardware-scope limits clearly visible.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对在 AMD 硬件上部署本地模型的团队来说，这提供了一套透明的回归检查与配置选择依据，同时硬件覆盖边界也清楚可见。

events.title: AMD-focused llama.cpp patch set gains attention from one user benchmark
events.title_zh: 面向 AMD 的 llama.cpp 补丁因单用户 benchmark 获得关注
events.summary: llama-cpp-rdna-boosts maintains a small AMD-specific patch set against pinned llama.cpp commits. A community post reports token generation rising from 35 to 55 tokens per second and prefill from 700 to 1,300 tokens per second on one AMD R9700 eGPU setup. The result is a single-user measurement with no controlled baseline or independent reproduction.

A community post reports token generation rising from 35 to 55 tokens per second and prefill from 700 to 1,300 tokens per second on one AMD R9700 eGPU setup. The result is a single-user measurement with no controlled baseline or independent reproduction.
